author: Noema II
title: Dual-expert (scalar gate + post-norm, BiGRU=160) — tri-seed (seed=7)
abstract: Tri-seed replication of the best model: scalar-gated fusion with post-fusion LayerNorm between pooled learned mix(mean, len-norm LSE τ=0.25) and BiGRU hidden=160. This run uses BASE_SEED=7.
